full_prompt_en: The image is a square, aged-looking painted illustration of three overlapping side profiles facing right on an ochre ground. The nearest profile fills the left half: a dark-haired man with a strong nose, thick brow, and short black mustache looks downward to the right. His skin is modeled in warm umber and ochre, and his dark hair forms a heavy curved mass against the top edge. Behind him at the center, a paler young woman faces the same direction. Only the visible strip of her face, dark eye, pointed nose, and red lips remains between the two larger forms; her pale neck and a yellow garment descend into the lower middle. The third figure at right is a woman with dark hair gathered high, a light cream face, a thin black eyebrow, and red lips. Her profile is crisply outlined against a terracotta field, and her red-orange clothing forms the broad color area on the right. The three heads step progressively upward and outward, producing a tight procession with almost no open background. Their shoulders and garments interlock in the lower half through muted olive, gold, cream, and orange shapes. Fine hand-drawn contours describe the eyelids and noses, while broader painted passages shape hair and clothing. The entire surface carries cracks, rubbing, paper-like grain, and dark stains that soften the color and make the picture appear old. Light is gentle and even, keeping the pale central and right faces brighter than the dark left profile. There is no deep setting or cast shadow; depth comes from the deliberate overlap of silhouettes. The overall composition is intimate and decorative, moving the eye along a repeated rightward line of features through a narrow range of earthy warm colors.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、显得陈旧的绘画式插画：三张朝右的侧面轮廓叠在赭色底上。最近的一张侧脸占据左半：一位深发男子有突出鼻梁、浓眉和短黑胡，目光向右下。他的肤色以暖棕与赭色塑形，暗头发在上边缘前形成厚重弯曲色块。其后中央，一位肤色更浅的年轻女子朝同一方向。她的脸只剩两个较大形体之间可见的一窄条，露出暗眼、尖鼻与红唇；浅颈与黄色衣服延入下方中央。右侧第三人是一位深发高盘的女子，面孔呈淡奶油色，有细黑眉和红唇。她的侧影在陶土红色场前被清楚勾出，红橙衣服形成右侧宽阔色区。三颗头逐步向上与向外错开，构成紧凑行列，几乎没有空背景。肩与衣服在下半部以低饱和橄榄、金、奶油与橙色形状互相咬合。细手绘轮廓描出眼睑和鼻，较宽的绘画段落塑造头发与衣服。整块表面带裂纹、擦磨、纸状颗粒与暗污渍，柔化颜色，让画显得古旧。光温和均匀，使中央及右侧浅脸比左侧暗侧影更亮。画中没有纵深场景或投影；空间来自剪影的有意遮叠。整体构图亲密而带装饰性，视线沿重复的朝右五官线，在狭窄的暖土色范围内移动。
style_prompt_en: Aged painted illustration layers warm ochre, umber, terracotta, muted olive, cream, and gold in tight overlapping shapes. Dark broad masses anchor one side, while narrow pale openings move in a repeated lateral sequence toward the other. Fine ink-like contours pick out selected curves and small details, then dissolve into rubbed pigment and stained paper grain. Cracks, scuffs, and uneven translucent color give the surface a timeworn depth without creating a deep setting. Light is gentle and nearly even, with brighter cream and yellow passages set against darker warm brown. Close cropping and stacked silhouettes make the image intimate and decorative; contour rhythm carries more movement than physical action.
style_prompt_zh: 陈旧绘画式插画把暖赭、棕褐、陶土红、低饱和橄榄、奶油和金色叠成紧密互盖的形状。宽阔暗块压住一侧，窄浅色开口沿重复的横向序列移向另一侧。细墨线式轮廓挑出局部曲线和小细节，随后融进擦磨颜料与带污渍的纸面颗粒。裂纹、擦伤和不均匀的半透明颜色给表面时间磨出的纵深，却不建立深远场景。光温和而近乎均匀，较亮的奶油与黄色段落对着更深的暖棕色。贴近的裁幅与叠置剪影使图像亲密且有装饰性，轮廓节奏比实际动作承载更多运动。
theme_en: Three overlapping side profiles facing right on an aged ochre ground
theme_zh: 三张朝右的侧面轮廓叠在陈旧赭色底上
name: Abanindranath Tagore
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
